For hot Indian weather, I’d favour fresh/citrusy or airy scents over very sweet vanilla-heavy mists.

Bath & Body Works Gingham Fine Fragrance Mist — ₹1,099
Fresh, clean and versatile, making it particularly suitable for daily office/college wear. 
Bath & Body Works

Plum BodyLovin’ Petals On The Rocks — ₹383 / 100 ml
Bergamot, mandarin, rose and patchouli give it a brighter citrus-floral character. Plum specifically markets it as long-lasting; it also has a 7-day return/replacement policy. 
Plum Goodness

Plum BodyLovin’ Hawaiian Rumba — ₹495 / 150 ml
A tropical, fruity option with substantially more volume for the money; currently listed at ₹495 on Tira. 
tirabeauty.com

Key difference: Gingham is the more polished everyday choice; Petals On The Rocks is fresher/citrus-floral; Hawaiian Rumba is more tropical and playful. Note that body mists generally won’t match perfume longevity, particularly in high humidity.
